About_Us.desc:
Smart File Aide is a straightforward tool designed to help you organize your device's internal storage and quickly locate your files.
Key Features:
Storage Overview & Quick Access: Check your storage usage at a glance and browse files automatically categorized by type
Recent Files Management: Easily view and track recently added files
Storage Cleanup: Free up space using dedicated tools to find and delete Similar Photos, Screenshots, Big Files, Empty Folders, and Useless Files
File Details: View specific file paths, sizes, and editing dates
Safe & Starred Folders: Keep sensitive files hidden in the Safe Folder or mark important ones for quick access

ques.que: How to use Smart File Aide Launcher?
ques.ans:
Step 1: Open the Flashlight Panel
	Swipe to access the file panel, then check storage, browse files, remove duplicates, hide sensitive data, and recover deleted items – all locally on your device.

	Step 2: Quick Google Search Access
	Use the Google search bar on the main page to perform searches directly fryour home screen. Whether you prefer typing or voice commands, this featurhakes it quick and easy to find what you need without launching a separateincreasing your productivity.

ques.que: Why does my home screen look different?
ques.ans:
Smart File Aide Launcher gives your home screen a new layout designed for quicker access to flashlight tools, useful shortcuts, and your apps.
	If you want to access your apps, just swipe up from the bottom of the screen to find and open them easily.

ques.que: How to use Smart File Aide Launcher?
ques.ans: If you're not satisfied with the new layout, you can switch back to your previous launcher at any time. Keep in mind that if you stop using Smart File Aide Launcher as your default home app, quick access to flashlight tools and launcher features may no longer be available. To switch back, tap the button below to set your preferred launcher as the default.
